description: Header file defining functions, macros, and configurations related to thermistor sensors in the firmware, including temperature conversions and sensor initialization.

methods.name: getR1InVoltageDividor
methods.description: Calculates the resistance R1 based on voltage divider configuration.

methods.name: getR2InVoltageDividor
methods.description: Calculates the resistance R2 based on voltage divider configuration.

methods.name: getTempK
methods.description: Calculates temperature in Kelvin from resistance.

methods.name: convertKelvinToCelcius
methods.description: Converts Kelvin temperature to Celsius.

methods.name: convertCelsiusToKelvin
methods.description: Converts Celsius temperature to Kelvin.

methods.name: convertCelciustoF
methods.description: Converts Celsius to Fahrenheit.

methods.name: convertFtoCelcius
methods.description: Converts Fahrenheit to Celsius.

methods.name: getKelvinTemperature
methods.description: Computes Kelvin temperature from resistance and thermistor math data.

methods.name: getResistance
methods.description: Calculates resistance based on voltage and configuration.

methods.name: getTemperatureC
methods.description: Calculates Celsius temperature from resistance and thermistor math data.

methods.name: getCoolantTemperature
methods.description: Retrieves coolant temperature, depends on engine parameters.

methods.name: isValidCoolantTemperature
methods.description: Checks if coolant temperature reading is valid.

methods.name: getIntakeAirTemperature
methods.description: Retrieves intake air temperature, depends on engine parameters.

methods.name: isValidIntakeAirTemperature
methods.description: Checks if intake air temperature reading is valid.

methods.name: hasIatSensor
methods.description: Determines if Intake Air Temperature sensor is present.

methods.name: hasCltSensor
methods.description: Determines if Coolant Temperature sensor is present.

methods.name: setThermistorConfiguration
methods.description: Sets configuration parameters for thermistor sensors.

methods.name: initThermistors
methods.description: Initializes thermistor sensors, possibly with logging and engine parameters.

methods.name: setCommonNTCSensor
methods.description: Configures a thermistor as a common NTC sensor.

methods.name: setDodgeSensor
methods.description: Configures a thermistor for Dodge-specific sensor configurations.
